newsitem.title: ALBANIA: US says no experts helping Albania scheme crisis.
newsitem.headline: US says no experts helping Albania scheme crisis.

text.p: The United States has not sent advisers to Albania to help the ruling Democrats government overcome a crisis sparked by collapsing pyramid schemes, the U.S. embassy in Tirana said on Thursday.
The U.S. State Department said on Wednesday two analysts had flown to Tirana to help the embattled Albanian government.
The embassy confirmed that two U.S. government officials had come to Albania, but only to conduct a seminar on competition and consumer protection policies.
"Their work here has nothing to do with the problems confronting Albania from the collapse of the pyramid schemes," the embassy statement said.
